workStep.headline: TSRV AVO - DELAY ACTION
workStep.description:
BACKGROUND: REPORT OF F/O PITOT HEAT CB TRIPPED AND POSSIBLE RELAY DAMAGE. WO HAS BEEN RAISED TO CARRY OUT INSPECTIONS AND REPLACEMENTS AS REQUIRED.
ACTION: 1: OBSERVING ALL SAFETY PRECAUTIONS GAIN ACCESS TO THE AIRCRAFT.
2: REMOVE ELECTRICAL POWER FROM THE AIRCRAFT BEFORE PROCEEDING WITH THE INSPECTIONS BELOW.
3: GAIN ACCESS TO THE INTERIOR OF THE P18-2 AND P18-3 PANEL AND PERFORM THE FOLLOWING GENERAL VISUAL INSPECTIONS IAW AMM TASK 20-60-02-100-801:
A) INSPECT RELAY R1018, R1070 AND R1073 IN SITU AND RECORD IF ANY MOISTURE IS PRESENT OR IF THERE IS ANY EVIDENCE OF MOISTURE HAVING BEEN PRESENT (WATER STAINS ETC.).
B) INSPECT THE AREA AROUND RELAY R1018, R1070 AND R1073, AND RECORD IF ANY MOISTURE IS PRESENT OR IF THERE IS ANY EVIDENCE OF MOISTURE HAVING BEEN PRESENT (WATER STAINS ETC.).
C) INSPECT THE INSULATION BLANKET ADJACENT TO RELAYS, AND RECORD IF ANY MOISTURE IS PRESENT OR IF THERE IS ANY EVIDENCE OF MOISTURE HAVING BEEN PRESENT (WATER STAINS ETC.).
D) INSPECT THE LOWER SIDE OF THE BASE OF RELAYS IN SITU, INCLUDING THE VISIBLE WIRES, AND RECORD IF THERE IS ANY MOISTURE PRESENT OR EVIDENCE OF OR ARCING/BURNING (BLACK MARKS ETC.)
E) REMOVE RELAYS R1018, R1070 & R1073 AND INSPECT ALL CONTACTS OF BOTH THE RELAY AND BASE FOR THE PRESENCE OF MOISTURE AND/OR EVIDENCE OF ARCING/BURNING.
4: RECTIFY ANY FINDINGS BEFORE CONTINUING. REFER AS REQUIRED TO RELAY/BASE REPLACEMENT IAW SWPM 20-81. CLEANING IAW AMM TASK 20-60-02-100-803. RECORD THE PART NUMBER AND BATCH NUMBER OF ANY NEW PART INSTALLED.
5: IF NFF, REPLACE RELAY R1018, R1073 & INSTALL RELAY R1070 IAW 20-81 AND CLOSE THE P18-2 AND P18-3 PANEL.
6: IAW AMM TASK 30-31-00-750-801, PERFORM AN OPERATIONAL TEST OF THE AUTO AIR DATA SENSOR HEATING.
